title: goniophlebium nummularium
intro: Goniophlebium nummularium, commonly known as the Money Plant or the Chinese Evergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This epiphytic fern is valued for its air-purifying properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been found to have potential health benefits, including reducing stress and inflammation, and promoting cardiovascular health. Goniophlebium nummularium contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
